GNN Inference Event (gnn)¶

The gnn package provides the event and particle classes used during GNN inference runs. Import with:

from AnalysisG.events.gnn import EventGNN

EventGNN¶

EventGNN is an EventTemplate subclass wrapping <inference/gnn-event.h>. It inherits all base event properties (index, weight, Tree, Trees, etc.) and exposes no additional scalar fields — particle collections are registered via register_particle() inside CompileEvent.

Header file for the gnn_event class.

Defines the gnn_event class, which inherits from event_template, and is used to represent physics events structured for graph neural network inference and processing.

class gnn_event : public event_template¶
#include <gnn-event.h>

Represents a physics event for GNN inference.

This class provides a container for event-level observables (MET, phi, jet/lepton multiplicities), MVA predictions (top quark multiplicities, signal scores, edge scores), and stores both truth and reconstructed particles (tops, Z’, and general GNN particles).

Key Features:

  • Built-in templated reductions for extracting element properties into standard containers.

  • build: Constructs the event from raw element data.

  • CompileEvent: Finalizes the event structure by establishing edges and parent-child relationships.

Particle Classes¶

Top¶

Inferred top quark. Inherits all ParticleTemplate kinematics; no additional fields.

ZPrime¶

Inferred Z′ resonance particle. Inherits all ParticleTemplate kinematics; no additional fields.

Header file for GNN particle definitions.

This file contains the definitions of various particle classes used in GNN-based events, such as particle_gnn, top, and zprime, which all inherit from particle_template.

class particle_gnn : public particle_template¶
#include <gnn-particles.h>

General particle class for GNN processing.

Represents basic particles participating in the GNN, potentially tracking features such as whether the particle is a lepton (lep).
